name: Proposal Value Added Modules
description: Public proposal section (section_type value_added_modules) renders a card grid of included-free modules resolved from the proposal's functional_requirements groups. Each card shows title, icon, justification text, and a 'Gratis' badge. An optional footer_note is displayed below the grid. Falls back to 'Incluido sin costo adicional' when no title is provided in content_json. Clicking a card opens the shared requirements modal, including the nested linked-requirements link when technical requirements reference the module item ids. Per-module conditions gate benefits: when the effective total is below the module minimum a 'Disponible en proyectos desde $X' badge is shown (condicionado; never hidden), plus optional duration and discretionary-note badges. A 'Términos y condiciones' button opens a per-module ModuleTermsModal without triggering the card detail modal.
knownGaps: Terms modal now renders **bold** via renderInlineBold (2026-07); bold output not asserted (mock terms carry no ** markers).
